sceneConcept: A slender twenty-eight-year-old Chinese night-shift guard with a notably youthful face stands alone against a transparent background. Short straight black hair, dark brown eyes, faint under-eye shadows and a quiet guarded expression make him unobtrusive. He wears a plain navy security cardigan over a grey t-shirt, black trousers, a simple belt and dark shoes. His left hand holds exactly one perfectly blank white sheet upright, and his right hand holds one freshly sharpened wooden pencil. Soft even frontal studio light avoids dramatic screen glow. Visual refresh: a severe high-collar technical uniform with a biometric wrist connector and modular buckles.
